about_the_game:
Beneath the endless desert night, the masked Seers walk the Columns of the Three Sisters. Aelion, Veyra, and Cindral are the moons of Vaeraleth and the daughters of the absent Goddess, Nythera. Guided by the living Codex, you will uncover hidden stars, trace constellations, and wield mystical powers that only a Seer can command.

Each Sister’s domain challenges you in different ways:

  • Aelion reveals stars hidden in light and shadow.

  • Veyra shifts the heavens in constant motion.

  • Cindral traps you in cycles of memory and loss.

In each Observatory, you’ll hunt for clues within ancient murals, celestial instruments, fading echoes and more that will let you complete the Vision Box’s star patterns. Use your Seer ability to pierce illusions, slow the heavens, or reclaim what time has taken.

Every constellation you complete unlocks fragments of prophecy, verse, and visions, drawing you closer to truth of the Nythera.

Features

  • Constellation Rituals – Connect the stars in the Vision Box to complete each Sister’s challenge.

  • Unique Seer Abilities – Special abilities only accessible to Seers and their connection to the heavens above and the three celestial bodies that orbit Vaeraleth.

  • Observatory Exploration – Interact with murals, prisms, orreries, and relics to reveal crucial clues.

  • Lore Unlocked Through Play – Uncover prophecy fragments, beautiful artwork, and whispers from the past.

  • Atmospheric Worldbuilding – The drifting sands, veiled moons, and shadowed ruins of Vaeraleth.

short_description: The sky is lying to everyone but you. Step into the role of a Seer in this dark, atmospheric puzzle-adventure. Search ancient Observatories, reveal the stars it hides, and complete the Ritual that will shape the fate of all who walk beneath it.
